side_effects: Package binding or current provider construction occurs.

actions: Retain failure reason: absent identity, malformed index, invalid extent, QFS failure, or size mismatch.

actions: Open or validate the selected record extent.

side_effects: Original PFRecordRead/record map/open count may change; current B1 has no open lease.

actions: Close the original record/stream lease or discard current owned bytes after consumer parsing.
entry_actions: Ensure no decoder or renderer still borrows the record stream.
exit_actions: Release record references/open count and return to index-ready.
transitions.guard: Consumer no longer needs the record stream.
side_effects: Original record/stream references and open counts can change.
